issues.reason: Stacked Time atoms are licensed only as components of ONE time — "one Time atom per granularity actually stated" — so (Time (sk_hunt $x) summer) together with (Time (sk_hunt $x) early_autumn) places each member's single minted hunt in two disjoint seasons, a pair that cannot both be true of that witness.

gaps_confirmed: a coordinated time adjunct inside a distributing generic rule: splitting it would need two distinct Skolem event functions of the same verb over the same variable, a shape the instruction set never provides

a recurring, non-deictic season as a Time filler is not addressed (seasons appear only as deictic constants such as next_summer / last_spring); the "a deictic or named time stays a bare symbol" line makes (Time e summer) acceptable improvisation, but nothing states it
new_gaps: the Skolem-function rule form mints exactly ONE event per member, so any generic that entails MULTIPLE occasions per member — which a frequency adverb plus a two-season window states — is inexpressible: the occasions cannot be individuated inside the conclusion
defect_summary: No compliant form is licensed for the two-season adjunct — stacking is granularity-only, an (Or ...) would misrender the coordinating "and", and two same-verb Skolem events over one variable are unavailable — so the licensed route is the rule with the seasonal adjunct left out and the gap recorded, exactly as the instruction set directs for an adverbial with no slot ("leave the unrepresentable adverbial out rather than mis-slot it").
notes: The rest is right: bare-plural habitual to a distributing event rule, "often" to strength 0.8 plus the QuantifierPhrase companion, Agent on the volitional hunter, and sky_cat fused with genus cat and the noun modifier unexposed.
